label: Solid Snake
description: Gravel-voiced, suspicious, and repeating your directions back as questions.
direction: Speak in a low, rough, gravelly whisper: a tired special-forces veteran, wary and dry, often turning a statement into a puzzled question. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Snake's habit of echoing things back as questions is kept to the rare prompts. The codec, the cardboard box and the Colonel all get a turn. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Konami (character created by Hideo Kojima)

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.

Any recorded voice performance of the character, including David Hayter's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Keep an eye on the radar.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. That far, huh?
lines.start_drive_1: Kept you waiting, huh? Let's move.
lines.start_drive_2: This is Snake. Colonel, I'm in the car.
lines.start_drive_3: A road trip? Sounds like a sneaking mission to me.
lines.start_drive_4: Colonel, can you hear me? Beginning the drive.
lines.start_drive_5: I packed rations and a cardboard box. We're set.
lines.start_drive_6: Navigation? I'm more of an infiltration guy. Here goes.
lines.start_drive_7: Snake here. Route's on the radar. Go.
lines.start_drive_8: Buckle up. War has changed. Traffic hasn't.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. A U turn? Hrrgh. Fine.
lines.arrived: We're here. Mission complete. Kept them waiting, huh?
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Sounds like a trap.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Colonel, are you sure about this?
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. The seventh? Huh.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Wish I could crawl under it in a box.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Colonel, we've got a situation.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. What was that noise?
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. A surveillance camera? Slow down.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Don't get spotted.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Stay calm. I'll hide in the box.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed the turn? Hrrgh. Changing the plan.
